conditions: Holotype of Sillago nigrofasciata sp. nov. (sex not stated). Type material as printed: 'OUC_FEL178001, 151.2 mm SL, coastal area of Fuding, Fujian Province, China, collected by Yuan Li, January 2014' (holotype line as returned by the page reader); 107 paratypes from Fuding, Xiamen, Changhua, Zhuhai and Fangchenggang. Table 3 caption: 'Morphometric measurements for type specimens of Sillago nigrofasciata sp. nov.' Table 3 header row: 'Morphometric measurements (mm) and counts | Holotype | Paratypes (n = 107)'. The row logged is 'Eye diameter (ED) | 8.1 | 6.8-11.6' (holotype value, then the paratype range of 107 specimens, which is not logged). The next row, 'Eye diameter (ED), as % of HL | 17.9 | 16.5-24.9', gives the same eye as a proportion; the Description says 'Eye moderate, its margin slightly covered with adipose eyelid, diameter 17.9% (16.5-24.9%) of HL.' The 8.1 mm value is consistent with 17.9% of HL (HL about 45 mm for a 151.2 mm SL fish). The section label above the percentage rows is given as SL by one reading of the XML and HL by the CSV and the Description; the mm row sits above both.
